title: Category Lead
description: organization. In this role, you will leverage market intelligence, supplier relationships, financial analysis, and procurement expertise to optimize costs, mitigate risks, improve supplier performance, and support business growth objectives. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to drive innovative sourcing solutions and continuous improvement across the procurement ecosystem. Our Team The Procurement & Supply Chain team partners with Koch businesses to deliver strategic sourcing solutions that create value, improve operational efficiency, and support long-term business objectives. We work collaboratively with stakeholders, suppliers, and industry partners to develop innovative procurement strategies, strengthen supplier relationships, and enable sustainable business growth through principled decision-making and continuous improvement. What You Will Do Category Strategy & Management Develop and execute multi-year category strategies across indirect spend categories such as IT, Professional Services, Facilities, Marketing, HR Services, and other enterprise support functions. Apply category management expertise, including Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), should-cost modeling, value chain analysis, and financial assessments to identify and prioritize value creation opportunities. Conduct spend analysis, benchmarking, and market assessments to uncover sourcing opportunities, process improvements, and cost optimization initiatives. Monitor category performance, supplier spend, and savings targets while ensuring alignment with overall sourcing strategies. Adapt category strategies based on changing market conditions, business priorities, and supplier capabilities. Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation Lead end-to-end sourcing initiatives, including supplier identification, competitive tendering, evaluation, and selection processes. Develop sourcing strategies that balance business objectives, risk tolerance, and long-term value creation. Lead complex negotiations to secure optimal pricing, commercial terms, service levels, and contractual outcomes. Establish and manage price-setting mechanisms, benchmark analyses, and cost models aligned with category strategies. Drive continuous savings opportunities while maintaining quality, service, and supplier performance expectations. Supplier Relationship Management Build and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers and business partners. Develop supplier performance management frameworks to drive accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. Manage supplier onboarding processes, including due diligence, qualification, risk assessments, and governance requirements. Identify, assess, and mitigate supplier-related risks to ensure supply continuity and business resilience. Lead supplier development initiatives that support long-term value creation and strategic partnerships. Contract Management & Governance Lead contract development, negotiation, execution, and lifecycle management activities. Ensure agreements align with business needs while protecting organizational interests and mitigating risk. Oversee contractual compliance, including management of NDAs, DPAs, MSAs, and other commercial agreements. Ensure adherence to procurement policies, governance frameworks, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements. Monitor contract performance and implement improvements to maximize value realization. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to understand requirements and align sourcing strategies with business objectives. Lead cross-functional category teams and facilitate collaboration across multiple Koch businesses and functions. Present sourcing recommendations, category strategies, and market insights to senior leadership and key decision-makers. Drive change management initiatives that support procurement transformation and business performance improvements. Influence stakeholders through data-driven insights and effective communication. Procurement Technology & Continuous Improvement Leverage procurement platforms and digital technologies to improve sourcing processes and spend visibility. Utilize tools such as Ariba, Coupa, or similar procurement solutions to enhance category performance and operational efficiency. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that streamline procurement processes and improve business outcomes. Utilize analytics, reporting, and market intelligence tools to support strategic decision-making. Promote innovation and adoption of best practices across procurement and supplier management activities. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Procurement, or a related field. Proven experience in Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, Procurement Consulting, or related procurement functions focused on indirect spend categories. 5+ years of experience managing Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), category spend, and/or P&L ownership across multiple spend categories. Demonstrated success delivering cost savings, sourcing efficiencies, and transformational procurement initiatives. Experience developing and executing category strategies, competitive bidding processes, benchmarking exercises, should-cost analysis, and pricing frameworks. Strong understanding of procurement lifecycle processes, including Purchase Requisition (PR) to Purchase Order (PO) workflows. Experience managing supplier onboarding, qualification, due diligence, and risk management processes. Knowledge of contract management principles and commercial agreements, including NDAs, DPAs, and MSAs. Experience using procurement technologies such as Ariba, Coupa, SAP, or similar platforms. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for spend analysis, financial modeling, and reporting. Strong Power Point skills with experience developing executive-level presentations and category strategy communications. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels. Ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, and drive results in a dynamic environment. Flexibility to support business requirements across multiple shifts, including 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, 12:00 PM–9:00 PM, or other business-required schedules. What Will Put You Ahead Professional certifications such as CPSM, CIPS, CSCP, CPM, or equivalent procurement and supply chain credentials. Experience leading complex global sourcing initiatives across multiple geographies and business units. Strong expertise in indirect procurement categories such as IT, Professional Services, Facilities, Marketing, and HR Services. Experience utilizing advanced analytics, digital procurement tools, and spend intelligence platforms to drive sourcing strategies. Knowledge of supplier risk management frameworks and third-party risk assessment methodologies. Experience implementing procurement transformation, operating model redesign, or process optimization initiatives. Strong financial acumen with experience conducting value chain analysis, should-cost modeling, and business case development. Demonstrated ability to build strategic supplier partnerships that drive innovation and business growth. Experience working within manufacturing, shared services, global enterprise, or complex business environments. Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority. Who We Are At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value, and get rewarded for our individual contributions. We strive to create an environment where employees are empowered to realize their full potential while helping the business succeed

Drive operational excellence through workflow/queue and workforce planning for high-volume AP activities. Ensure strict adherence to service levels, process documentation, business controls, and compliance standards. title: SAP TM Analyst
description: organization with over 120,000 employees worldwide, with subsidiaries involved in manufacturing, trading, and investments. Koch Capabilities (KCC) is being developed in India to extend Koch’s IT operations and serve as a hub for innovation within the IT function. As KCC continues to scale, employees will have opportunities to build rewarding career paths within the organization. This role offers the opportunity to contribute from the ground floor and play a critical role in helping expand Koch Capabilities over the coming years. Working closely with global colleagues will also provide significant international exposure. Our Team This position will work with the Georgia-Pacific Building Products IT organization as part of the Order to Cash (OTC) team. This is a functional role that partners closely with key business SMEs on day-to-day support, new requirements, enhancements, and project initiatives. The successful candidate should have hands-on experience configuring and supporting SAP Transportation Management (TM) and demonstrate strong analytical skills, initiative, collaboration, and customer focus. What You Will Do Collaborate on SAP IM, LE, and TM processes in alignment with business projects. Demonstrate deep expertise in Inventory Management (IM), Logistics Execution (LE), and Transportation Management (TM), with strong integration capabilities across the logistics landscape including Yard Management, Load Optimization, and S/4HANA. Support system upgrades, enhancements, and future project initiatives. Troubleshoot and resolve customer-reported issues while providing day-to-day user support. Analyze complex business problems and recommend effective solution alternatives. Partner closely with business SMEs to design, deliver, and support solutions aligned with business strategies. Gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into functional and technical solutions. Drive enhancements and participate in all phases of projects including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, training, deployment, and support. Perform root cause analysis (RCA), impact assessments, documentation, and user training as required. Create and maintain functional specifications, configuration documents, and related project documentation. Develop and execute test plans, including unit testing, integration testing, and coordination of user acceptance testing (UAT). Collaborate effectively with SAP functional and technical teams across global locations. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree in a technology-related field. 8–10 years of experience working with SAP Transportation Management (TM). Strong functional and technical expertise in designing, configuring, and implementing SAP TM solutions. Minimum of one full-cycle SAP TM implementation experience. Strong integration knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, particularly within logistics processes. Experience configuring and customizing SAP IM, LE, and TM modules based on business requirements. Experience setting up logistics master data, including shipping conditions, routes, equipment, and plant-specific configurations. Ability to prepare functional specifications for WRICEF objects and validate technical designs. Experience conducting workshops, gap analysis, and fit-to-standard sessions. Strong ability to perform RCA, troubleshoot SAP TM issues, and provide user training. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Strong analytical, problem-solving, critical-thinking, and innovative mindset. What Will Put You Ahead Working knowledge of interface monitoring between SAP and external systems such as: Transportation Management Systems (TMS) Yard Management Systems (YMS) Inventory Management Systems (IM) Ortec Solutions SAP ABAP troubleshooting knowledge. SAP S/4HANA implementation experience. Experience within the Consumer Products or Process Manufacturing industries. Who We Are At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our Principle-Based Management™ philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We strive to create an environment where employees can perform at their best while helping the business achieve superior results.

title: Fullstack Developer
description: organization. You will work closely with product owners, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to build innovative solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes. What You Will Do · Designing and developing modern, scalable, and responsive web applications using React.js and Type Script. · Building and maintaining backend services and APIs using Node.js, Type Script, and serverless architectures. · Building end-to-end features including UI components, backend services, APIs, and data integrations. · Developing and consuming RESTful APIs to enable seamless integration with internal and external systems. · Implementing modern frontend experiences using responsive design and user-centric principles. · Designing backend services with robust error handling, logging, and performance optimisation. · Leveraging cloud-native services (AWS or equivalent) to build, deploy, scale and operate modern applications. · Implementing event-driven and asynchronous integration patterns where required. · Applying role-based access controls and authentication mechanisms aligned with enterprise standards. · Ensuring code quality through clean coding practices, design documentation, and peer reviews. · Collaborating with cross-functional teams including business stakeholders, architects, and operations teams. · Participating in Agile delivery cycles, providing regular updates on progress, risks, and dependencies. · Supporting application monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Strong expertise in React.js, Type Script, Java Script, HTML5, and CSS3 . Proven experience in full-stack software development. Hands-on experience building scalable backend services using Node.js and Type Script . Experience developing and deploying applications on AWS cloud platforms . title: Salesforce Specialist
description: requirements across Sales, Service, Experience, Commerce, and Marketing Cloud functions. The ideal candidate will bring strong Salesforce development experience, a good understanding of platform best practices, and the ability to collaborate closely with business stakeholders, Salesforce administrators, and cross-functional technology teams to deliver reliable and business-aligned solutions. Our Team This role will be part of the Salesforce technology team supporting Georgia-Pacific, with primary alignment to the Building Products and Consumer Products Group business units. The team partners closely with business stakeholders and technology teams to build, enhance, and support Salesforce applications that enable business operations and improve user experience. You will work in a collaborative environment where developers, administrators, business users, and other IT teams come together to solve problems, strengthen integrations, and continuously improve Salesforce solutions. What You Will Do Develop and enhance Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, Aura Components, and Lightning pages to support evolving business needs. Partner with Salesforce Administrators and business stakeholders to understand requirements, assess feasibility, and deliver scalable and secure solutions. Design and implement Salesforce integrations using APIs and collaborate with other IT/development teams to connect Salesforce with enterprise systems such as SAP, SAP CPI, Marketing Cloud, and other business applications. Support Salesforce platform enhancements while ensuring adherence to Salesforce best practices, coding standards, documentation, security considerations, scalability, and platform limits. Write, maintain, and improve test classes and technical documentation for custom Salesforce development. Take ownership of release cycles, including implementing and deploying new enhancements and updates to existing Salesforce applications and code. Work with large data sets and apply Salesforce development best practices, including bulkification and performance-conscious development. Gather requirements, interpret technical specifications, and present solutions clearly to business and technical stakeholders. Contribute to continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to improve existing code, processes, and Salesforce platform capabilities. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Experience in Salesforce development with hands-on expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, and Salesforce platform development. Experience working with Salesforce clouds such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud. Experience collaborating with business stakeholders, Salesforce administrators, and cross-functional technology teams to deliver Salesforce solutions. Experience with Salesforce APIs, integrations, and enterprise application connectivity. Experience writing technical specifications, maintaining code documentation, and developing/maintaining test classes for custom Salesforce development. Experience with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and Java Script. Salesforce Platform Developer I certification. What Will Put You Ahead Experience with additional Salesforce clouds such as Commerce Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Agentforce Additional Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer II, or Java Script Developer I. Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, SAP CPI, Marketing Cloud, or other enterprise business applications. Experience working with large data volumes, performance optimisation, and bulkification concepts in Salesforce. Exposure to other technologies or languages such as XML, Java Script, .NET, SQL, C++, or SOAP-based web services. Bachelor’s degree, postgraduate degree, professional qualification, or equivalent relevant experience. Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and active participation in the Salesforce community. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs.
